verdict.rationale: Glama offers some non-interactive automation: the pricing page says workflows can be automated via schedules or webhooks, hosting builds images straight from a connected GitHub repo, and agents call the Gateway endpoint programmatically. However, there is no documented CLI, CI integration, or published API spec (the OpenAPI probes all returned 404). A community user also reports that API-triggered resyncs silently failed for days because of an undocumented billing requirement. missing for 10: documented CLI or headless mode, CI pipeline integration docs (e.g. GitHub Actions), a published API/OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on evidence of working headless automation.
